title: hebe × obovata
intro: Hebe × obovata, commonly known as the hybrid Hebe, is a flowering plant that belongs to the family Plantaginaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from anxiety, insomnia, and hypertension due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Hebe × obovata are attributed to its ability to act as an anxiolytic, hypnotic, and vasodilator, helping to reduce stress and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of Hebe × obovata include iridoid glycosides, which are responsible for its pharmacological effects, and other compounds such as flavonoids and phenolic acids, which contribute to its antioxidant properties.
